name: scala
description: Scala skill for Scala 3 and 2.13 (follows the project's syntax): ADTs, given/using and implicits, missing type class instances such as Ordering, Futures and effects, MUnit FunSuite and ScalaTest suites, scalafmt, 2.13 to 3 migration. Also configures the Metals language server for .scala, .sc and .sbt files.
